    """
    Calculate the logarithmic distance between two numbers.
    Applies logarithmic transformation while preserving signs, then calculates distance.
    """
    if a == b:
        return 0
    
    # Apply logarithmic transformation while preserving sign
    # To deal with numbers close to zero, add offset
    abs_a_plus_offset = abs(a) + MATH_LOG_OFFSET
    abs_b_plus_offset = abs(b) + MATH_LOG_OFFSET
    
    log_a = math.copysign(math.log(abs_a_plus_offset), a)
    log_b = math.copysign(math.log(abs_b_plus_offset), b)
    
    # Calculate distance between log-transformed values
    divisor = log_a + log_b
    if divisor == 0:
        return 1
    
    try:
        distance = abs((log_a - log_b) / divisor)
